functionDeclarations.name: update_topic
functionDeclarations.description: Manages your narrative flow. Include `title` and `summary` only when starting a new Chapter (logical phase) or shifting strategic intent.

title.description: The title of the new topic or chapter.

summary.description: (OPTIONAL) A detailed summary (5-10 sentences) covering both the work completed in the previous topic and the strategic intent of the new topic. This is required when transitioning between topics to maintain continuity.

strategic_intent.description: A mandatory one-sentence statement of your immediate intent.

wait_for_previous.description: Set to true to wait for all previously requested tools in this turn to complete before starting. Set to false (or omit) to run in parallel. Use true when this tool depends on the output of previous tools.

functionDeclarations.name: read_file
functionDeclarations.description: Reads and returns the content of a specified file. If the file is large, the content will be truncated. The tool's response will clearly indicate if truncation has occurred and will provide details on how to read more of the file using the 'start_line' and 'end_line' parameters. Handles text, images (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, SVG, BMP), audio files (MP3, WAV, AIFF, AAC, OGG, FLAC), and PDF files. For text files, it can read specific line ranges.

file_path.description: The path to the file to read.

start_line.description: Optional: The 1-based line number to start reading from.

end_line.description: Optional: The 1-based line number to end reading at (inclusive).
